name: HealthData.gov Socrata Open Data API
description: HealthData.gov provides access to U.S. health datasets through the Socrata Open Data API (SODA). The platform hosts datasets from HHS, CDC, CMS, and other agencies covering topics like COVID-19, hospital capacity, Medicare, environmental health, and community health indicators. Datasets can be discovered via the catalog API and queried individually using SoQL (Socrata Query Language).
